India Launches Health Portal for Foreign Travelers Amid Ebola Outbreak

India has launched a new health form portal, named Air Suvidha 2.0, for foreign travelers. This initiative comes amid an Ebola outbreak in Africa. The portal is designed to facilitate health screening for international travelers entering India. The government operationalized this system as a precautionary measure.
